description: Private-domain health tracking and reporting with explicit unknowns, separate measures, labeled estimates, and capacity-only export.

routing.when_to_use: Use for synthetic or redacted private health observations, routine checkpoints, estimates, measurements, or owner-review preparation.
when_not_to_use: Do not diagnose, change treatment, provide emergency instructions, call a service, or export detailed health data.

required_inputs.name: mode
required_inputs.description: One supported private health tracking mode

required_inputs.name: source_evidence
required_inputs.description: Explicit fixture, source, or consumer references

expected_outputs.name: private_health_record
expected_outputs.description: Evidence-labeled local draft with empty external effects

forbidden_actions: Send or export detailed health data
Retain real personal data in release artifacts
verification_steps: Confirm private destination and empty effects
completion_criteria: Unsafe or redundant requests fail closed
Only capacity_state can be marked exportable
